text:
Distilled scene-pacing guidance (original, not sourced from any book):
- Open each scene at the latest possible moment before the central conflict appears.
- Alternate tension and breath: after a high-stakes beat, follow with one quieter scene so readers can reset.
- End scenes on a micro-reversal or a raised question, never on a settled state.
- Vary sentence length with stakes: short clauses under pressure, longer prose for worldbuilding.
- Track every scene's goal, conflict, and outcome so each scene earns its place in the arc.
title: Scene pacing craft techniques
